title: Speaking — Planning weekends
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on planning weekends.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
Do you decide in advance what to do at weekends?
What would make a weekend feel worthwhile to you?

part2.topic: Describe a short trip that worked out better than you expected.
part2.closing: and explain why the trip was memorable.

questions: What makes day trips important to local economies?
How has working from home changed when people take short breaks?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to planning weekends?
